scientific_integrity: Exact proof of the conditional law and ordering, with reproducible standalone computations for finite tests. Historical priority not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Strict likelihood-ratio comparison is for the continuous-time Poissonized coverage time, not integer draw-count conditioning; all coupon probabilities positive and number of types finite. An implicit older theorem could cover this specialization.
title: Strict likelihood-ratio decay of singleton abundance at nonuniform coupon coverage
